line: A second-person 'what if' explainer acted out by 16-bit pixel characters in a 2.5D Three.js stage: RPG dialogue and choice boxes, a slot-wheel title, and bullet-time shots with a crawling real-time clock.

source: Own finished film《如果你的反应快10倍》v7 (2026-11-10). Story adapted from Ifverse (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MroF1XmHOZw) — adaptation reference only; no Ifverse footage or frames are stored here.
